points.description: States that the peak discharge (peak outflow) is reduced/attenuated/lowered by the reservoir.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says flood flow is reduced or controlled without mentioning the peak.

points.description: States that the peak flow is shifted/delayed in time (occurs later; lag in the peak).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely mentions timing change or delay of flow without clearly relating it to the peak.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating both ideas in any wording: peak outflow is reduced (attenuation) and the peak is delayed/shifted in time (lag). Give one mark for each idea; part marks for vague but relevant versions. No marks for unrelated answers such as storage or evaporation. Extra remarks do not cost marks.
